uncited: - **Definition:** An end-to-end method to optimize both SDF and reconstructed meshes jointly, predicting surface meshes from images.
Use DeepSDF conditioned on these latent vectors to learn the implicit shape representation.
Prediction: Predict SDF values on a regular grid $f_\theta(G)$ and use SDC to reconstruct mesh $M = \text{SDC}(S_G)$ via a forward pass of the SDC network.
Training Schedule: Initially train DeepSDF (with image encoder) and SDC independently.

- **Formula:** Joint Learning Loss: $\mathcal{L}_{\text{SVR}} = \mathcal{L}_{\text{SDF}} + \alpha_3 \mathcal{L}_{\text{SDR}} + \alpha_4 \mathcal{L}_{\text{D}}$, where $\mathcal{L}_{\text{SDF}}$ and $\mathcal{L}_{\text{SDR}}$ reconstruct/regularize the implicit representation, and $\mathcal{L}_{\text{D}}$ trains SDC.
The surface is the zero level set $\{\mathbf{x} : \phi(\mathbf{x}) = 0\}$.
Insert an intermediary hidden layer (bottleneck) with dimensionality smaller than the input and output layers.
